stem:
Read the sentence from paragraph 5 of the excerpt from The Last Wild Place.

Chip and Luther first climbed up into the loft to check out the view.

Which lines from the poem "A Wave of a Day" contain a SIMILAR idea?

options.label: A
options.text:
I watch him like I always have,

on his surfboard along the horizon. (lines 1–2)

options.label: B
options.text:
thrilled for him to finally share

all of his surfing knowledge. (lines 7–8)

options.label: C
options.text:
"Yes!" I respond loudly in the wind—

so happy that he's back home with me! (lines 13–14)

options.label: D
options.text:
"Well, first," he laughs, "there's something to know

before venturing out to the sea. (lines 15–16)

visual_elements: boxed sentence: Chip and Luther first climbed up into the loft to check out the view.
